description: This file defines FastAPI endpoints for managing 'proctor events' including ingestion (single and bulk), and querying with filters and pagination. It includes data models with Pydantic for request and response schemas, and interacts with a SQLAlchemy ORM model for database persistence.

classes.name: EventIn
classes.description: Pydantic model for incoming event data, including session_id, attempt_id, event_type, and optional payload.

classes.name: EventOut
classes.description: Pydantic model for outgoing event data, including id, session_id, attempt_id, event_type, payload, and occurred_at. Uses from_attributes config for ORM instances.

classes.name: BulkEventsIn
classes.description: Pydantic model for batch ingestion, containing a list of EventIn objects.

classes.name: PaginatedEvents
classes.description: Pydantic model for paginated list of EventOut objects along with total count, page, and size.

methods.name: ingest_event(payload: EventIn, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to ingest a single event, creates a ProctorEvent ORM object, commits, and returns it.

methods.name: ingest_events_bulk(body: BulkEventsIn, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Bulk ingestion endpoint for multiple events, adds all to DB in a single transaction, returns count ingested.

methods.name: list_events( db: Session = Depends(get_db), page: int = Query(1, ge=1, description="Page number"), size: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=200, description="Page size"), attempt_id: Optional[int] = Query(None, description="Filter by attempt id"), session_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by session id"), event_type: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by event type"), sort: str = Query("desc", description="Sort by occurred_at: asc|desc"), )
methods.description: Query endpoint that returns a paginated, filtered list of events sorted by occurrence time.

ctags.name: attempt_id
ctags.pattern: /^    attempt_id: int = Field(..., description="Attempt ID this event belongs to")$/

ctags.name: event_type
ctags.pattern: /^    event_type: str = Field(..., description="Event type string")$/

ctags.name: events
ctags.pattern: /^    events: List[EventIn] = Field(..., description="List of events to ingest in bulk")$/

ctags.name: list_events
ctags.signature: ( db: Session = Depends(get_db), page: int = Query(1, ge=1, description="Page number"), size: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=200, description="Page size"), attempt_id: Optional[int] = Query(None, description="Filter by attempt id"), session_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by session id"), event_type: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by event type"), sort: str = Query("desc", description="Sort by occurred_at: asc|desc"), )

ctags.name: session_id
ctags.pattern: /^    session_id: str = Field(..., description="Client session identifier")$/
